findings.finding: Metadata excludes named correspondence and online contexts, but does not read TimeControl or establish classical human play; computer and offline rapid/blitz events can remain.
Any FEN tag is excluded, including a repeated ordinary starting position; non-Standard Variant tags are excluded.
The full main line is legally replayed before its position hits are committed; variations do not supply played positions.
Unknown dates become latest possible dates for precedent ordering; they are bounds, not actual playing days.
Championship metadata, exact target-score copies and near copies with at least 70 percent shared positions serve the retired precedent question; they are not the learning sample exclusions.
The rated subset requires both sides at least 2200; it is not mover-specific Elo-band sampling.
Annual bottom-10000 sampling uses DefaultHasher over an output argument and source ordinal; no frozen 20261016 seed or one-player-year cap.

decision: Do not reuse exclusion ordinals, rated-subset flags or sample priorities for the new learning analysis.
limits: This is a source-code audit; it does not certify the identities or metadata of retained archive games.
